 A university professor in Spain has gone viral on social media after clearing his students' academic schedule and postponing a major examination so they can enjoy the long-awaited launch of Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA VI )
 The heartwarming gesture comes as global anticipation reaches fever pitch ahead of Rockstar Games' 19 November release, a 13-year wait following the 2013 debut of GTA V .
One economist projected that roughly 1.5 million Americans could call in sick on launch day, while major consumer brands have joined the frenzy. Xbox enlisted music producer DJ Khaled to issue mock medical notes, and KFC Australia staged a fake funeral campaign to give fans an excuse to stay home.
 Image via @youtube (Instagram) 
 For one Spanish university class, however, no excuses were necessary
 In an email written in Spanish and widely shared on X on 16 November, the lecturer informed students that his subject would have no homework, projects, or submission deadlines throughout GTA VI 's release week.
 En españa, un profesor le suspendio todas las tareas y evaluaciones a los alumnos para que puedan disfrutar el GTA 6
Tiene mas ganas de jugar el que todos los pibes jsjs https://t.co/YgvACvursu
— ElBuni (@therealbuni) November 16, 2026 
 The academic also postponed an upcoming examination from 23 November to 30 November, giving undergraduates time to organise their schedules and enjoy extra leisure time.
 Reflecting on his own youth, the lecturer noted that he was the exact same age as his students when GTA V arrived in 2013. He recalled how eagerly he rushed home to play the game and how it dominated conversations among his peers.
 The academic reprieve did come with a clear condition.
The professor apologised for imposing an unusually heavy workload the preceding week, explaining that he had deliberately accelerated the syllabus so the class stayed on schedule before the break.
He warned students that academic rigour would resume immediately after launch week.
 He also advised the class to play responsibly, reminding them that mature age ratings for GTA VI flag explicit themes including substance use, sexual content, and graphic violence
 Signing off his message, the lecturer wrote that he had enjoyed his own generational milestone with GTA V and felt genuinely excited for his students to experience theirs with GTA VI .
